title: MCP examples: context recovery and adding S3
description: Two distinct historical examples, not a continuous run.

scenes.title: Two additional MCP examples
lines: Edited reenactments based on project sessions.
These are not continuations of the three-protocol install.
scenes.narration: Two examples from separate historical sessions show context recovery and adding S3. These are edited reenactments, not one continuous run.

scenes.title: 1. Recover the operation context
lines: Large operation log returned through the tool harness.
Saved output reviewed for failures, recap and completion.
Summarize the evidence before deciding the next action.
scenes.narration: The agent retrieves an operation’s output and checks the saved log for failures and completion evidence. This recovers the state before another action, rather than assuming a quiet operation has finished.

scenes.title: 2. Add S3 to an existing cluster
lines: DIFFERENT SESSION: NFS and SMB already running
Recorded result: S3 ACTIVE; NFS and SMB remain active.
This is an extension, not the earlier fresh installation.
scenes.narration: In another session, NFS and SMB already run. The agent enables S3, runs the precheck, and deploys. The recorded result shows S3 active with the existing protocols undisturbed.

scenes.title: Closing
lines: CHECK STATE -> MAKE THE CHANGE -> VERIFY
See the full MCP story for an end-to-end example.
scenes.narration: Each example connects a short request to a verified result.
